name: ai-work-review
description: Review and approve AI's work on your markdown vault: rule checks, AI report ingestion, proposal diff with confirmed replacement.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/install-to-vault.mjs
